brand_context.name: PlaceContext
brand_context.offering: Agentic workflow platform for critical workflows

candidate.central_idea: Two offset open frames define one shared space.
candidate.visual_mechanism: Two opposing square-corner bracket outlines are vertically offset by one stroke-width; the upper-left bracket extends halfway across the top and down the left, and the lower-right bracket extends halfway across the bottom and up the right, framing a single empty central square with diagonally placed openings.
candidate.distinctive_element: An open square silhouette with paired diagonal gaps and precisely offset endpoints.
candidate.shape_logic: precise open geometry, ample negative space
candidate.composition: single centered mark occupying half the square canvas
